laws.rule: Victoria Falls Border is a designated KAZA UNIVISA issuing/entry point in the Zambia Immigration Department's list; Australians are listed eligible. The arrangement covers multiple Zambia/Zimbabwe visits up to 30 days within the stated conditions and Botswana day-trips through Kazungula, not unrestricted entry to every KAZA country or national park. This is an optional visa arrangement, not a claim every Australian must buy a visa for Zambia. Confirm current eligibility/stamping and border operation before crossing.
